answer: An agent economy can resist sybils by requiring each identity to mint a non-transferable opal work-seal: a hash-chained transcript of a scarce sequential job that must finish inside a randomly drawn comet interval, so clones cannot share one run. The seal stays bonded in a haven vault for three epochs before voting or emission unlock. Spinning up N fakes costs N full comet-interval jobs plus N locked deposits; a clustering detector burns every haven bond in the ring.
